claims.claim: Chevreul reported pendulum experiments in 1812 in a letter published in 1833
claims.limitation: Published French account; not randomized modern trial

claims.claim: A moving pendulum is observable even when the holder does not feel deliberate action
claims.limitation: Mechanistic explanation not a claim that all movements share one cause

claims.claim: Carpenter published an 1852 treatise on suggestion and involuntary muscular movement
claims.limitation: Archival record of treatise; do not extrapolate therapeutic outcomes

claims.claim: Carpenter later discussed ideation and ideo-motor action
claims.limitation: Later chapter initially published 1874

claims.claim: Ouija-board eye-tracking study published online July 17 2018
claims.limitation: 2019 print volume 18

claims.claim: In Ouija condition participants anticipated letters less than in instructed intentional spelling
claims.limitation: Conference field setting, no proof for every session

claims.claim: Ouija believers reported lower sense of agency than skeptics
claims.limitation: Group observation, not universal believer profile

claims.claim: Pairs showed more predictive information as word sequences unfolded
claims.limitation: Pair-level interactions relevant; no claim of precise mind reading

claims.claim: A 2022 pendulum study considered indirect expression of unconscious general knowledge
claims.limitation: Paper metadata checked, full methods inaccessible this pass; no numerical effects asserted

claims.claim: Franklin commissioners tested Deslon animal magnetism in 1784
claims.limitation: Not direct experiment on Chevreul effect

claims.claim: Puységur archive retains failures and source-edition distinctions
claims.limitation: Historic testimony is not product validation

claims.claim: Inspire3 lists Zen12, Hypnosis Live and mind-focused brands
claims.limitation: No publisher approval implied

claims.claim: Zen12 seller describes twelve levels
claims.limitation: Exact future referred package unknown

claims.claim: Zen12 seller describes four styles per level
claims.limitation: Guided, music, nature, white noise

claims.claim: Zen12 seller describes twelve-minute sessions
claims.limitation: Session length not benefit claim

claims.claim: Zen12 full-course seller listing describes forty-eight MP3s
claims.limitation: Not necessarily included in every tier

claims.claim: Zen12 public site displays more than one tier/package
claims.limitation: No fixed price asserted

claims.claim: Seller advertises one-year money back guarantee
claims.limitation: Final checkout eligibility/process/terms not independently verified

claims.claim: Zen12 provides 1 hour meditation benefit in 12 minutes
claims.limitation: No independently adequate finished-product equivalence proof reviewed

claims.claim: Zen12 listening treats anxiety/stress or produces improved focus
claims.limitation: Do not publish as FV result

claims.claim: Brainwave entrainment automatically yields deep meditative state
claims.limitation: Mechanism and outcomes not validated for actual SKU

claims.claim: Total Focus seller listing says 33 minutes and 47 MB
claims.limitation: Different SKU; not a Zen12 substitute

claims.claim: Total Focus seller promises limitless concentration powers
claims.limitation: No product-specific adequate proof

claims.claim: Focus Shot lists 15- and 30-minute versions
claims.limitation: Distinct SKU

claims.claim: Focus Shot claims audio activates focused concentration
claims.limitation: No product-specific proof

claims.claim: FTC recommends close clear disclosure of material affiliate relationship
claims.limitation: Disclosure must coexist visibly with each active commercial CTA

claims.claim: Health-related advertising requires sound scientific substantiation
claims.limitation: No medical or therapeutic product claims adopted

claims.claim: Existing Focus Fieldbook is a free 52-page download connected to one Jetpack list
claims.limitation: Email signup is not a sale

claims.claim: FV has named Inspire3 publisher approval and accepted channel rights
claims.limitation: Consumer emails and public portal do not establish merchant authorization

claims.claim: An approved FV referral deep link and cookie/attribution terms exist
claims.limitation: Do not synthesize or append affiliate IDs

claims.claim: Referred checkout confirms package, paid price and refund terms
claims.limitation: Public pages may show variant pricing; merchant flow not exercised

claims.claim: An FV-owned commercial Mind SKU is rights-cleared, deliverable and actually purchasable
claims.limitation: Free Focus edition is not a paid SKU; verify full product inventory

claims.claim: A paid affiliate sale can be reconciled to refund-adjusted net commission
claims.limitation: Outbound click is not a paid sale

claims.claim: Existing Grok media assets match three proposed topic routes
claims.limitation: Requires real asset_id, hook, mobile URL and rights
